_meta.what: Per-channel receipts for the latest published day, drawn from the same sampled ngrams corpus the day's scores are computed from: every English article in the sample whose text matched a registered channel phrase (channel anchor applied per document, identically to the series matcher), tier-sorted using source_tiers.json.
_meta.caveat: The corpus is a stratified sample of the day's monitored English web coverage (39 half-hourly files, 28,575 articles), so match counts are sample counts, not a census of everything GDELT saw that day. An article labeled 'in scored sample' is one the day's estimator actually counted; articles labeled 'retrieved' come from GDELT's bounded relevance search over the full day and restore wire originals whose syndicated copies the sample caught. Tiers order presentation and feed the tier 1-2 share only; they never enter any score.
